desc: The ATI Rukx double gun case is designed to protect two rifles at the same time. The rugged and tough 600 D polyester construction features multiple storage compartments and areas to keep all of your gear readily available. Heavy-duty, non-rust zippers and the polyester material provide for a very water resistant case. Wide carry handles distribute and balance the load for easy carry. The ATI Rukx gun case is built for rugged conditions and superior protection of your firearms.
